newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to buy German submarines - report.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to buy German submarines - report.

text.p: Indonesia will sign a memorandum of understanding with Germany next month for the purchase of several U-206 submarines, the Indonesian Observer newspaper reported on Friday.
The newspaper quoted chief of naval staff Admiral Arief Kusyariadi as saying the deal would be signed in September, but added he did not give details about the type of vessel or the number.

The newspaper also quoted German officials as saying that Indonesia was interested in the U-206 submarine. Jane's Defence Weekly said in June that the deal could involve five Type 206 submarines, which are being retired by the German navy.
Other military officials have said that Indonesia is considering buying up to six submarines from European nations, the Indonesian Observer said.
Indonesia's navy currently has two submarines, both German-made U-209s.
It also has 17 frigates, 57 patrol and coastal combat craft, 35 patrol craft, 13 anti-mining vessels, 28 amphibious vessels and 15 other ships for support.
